Dengue

General health-awareness information about Dengue.

Symptoms: symptoms vary by person and condition.

Transmission: May spread through an infectious agent or exposure route specific to the condition.

Prevention: follow appropriate public-health guidance maintain hygiene and healthy routines seek professional advice when concerned
